data.gender_notes: Sasmita is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sasmita is a Sanskrit name that translates to 'She who is adorned with knowledge'. In Hindu mythology, Sasmita is a name of Goddess Saraswati, who is the goddess of knowledge, music, art, wisdom, and learning. The name Sasmita carries the meaning “Goddess of Wisdom and Beauty” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Sasmita usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wisdom and beauty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
